title: Business-Wrap edits file
description: Ordered list of human edits made in the HTML editor on top of a document JSON. Replaying ops in order on the base document (matched by baseHash) must give the edited document. Targets are RFC 6901 JSON Pointers into the document JSON (e.g. /chapters/2/sections/0/blocks/1/rows/3/2). Pointers are resolved against the document state AFTER all previous ops. Diagram blocks (kind 'diagram', bible/contracts/diagram.schema.json) are edited with the same ops: replace on <block>/model (the editor writes one replace per gesture) or setText on a node or edge label. Version 1 files stay valid; nothing changed in the op set.

baseHash.description: sha256 of the base document JSON bytes the ops apply to. Replay refuses on mismatch.

locale.description: Edition edited. ar = RTL, en = LTR.

author.description: Free text initials; never an email or ID number.

richLeaf.description: A text leaf with formatting (0.13.0, A26): marks [start, end, type, value?] over text; link = http/https/mailto, color = #rrggbb, font = a Thmanyah family, size = pt. Wherever a string leaf is allowed a rich leaf is too; engine/edits.mjs textOf() reads either.

id.description: Optional op id for undo/redo bookkeeping.

old.description: previous leaf: a string, or a rich leaf (0.13.0) whose marks the new words keep

oneOf.description: Replace the words of a text leaf (paragraph, cell, title, caption). On a rich leaf ({text, marks, style}, 0.13.0) the marks are kept, rebased by common prefix/suffix. old = previous leaf, for conflict check and undo.
Insert value into an array; path ends with the target index or '-' for append (block, row, column cell, paragraph, story).
Remove the array item or object member at path. old = removed value, for undo.
Move the node at from to path (JSON Patch move semantics). Used for drag-reorder of blocks, rows, sections.
Copy the array item at path and insert it at to (default: right after path).

themeOverrides.description: Token overrides by DTCG token path (e.g. 'color.accent.primary', 'type.size.body'), value in the token's own type. Applied on top of the design pack.

documentFields.description: Document JSON members the ops may write (any pointer is allowed; these are the ones the renderer, the PDF and the DOCX read). Everything printed is editable.

labels.description: This document's printed labels over the house defaults (engine/i18n.json doc.<locale>) and the design pack's (theme.labels.<locale>): kicker, subtitle, controlChapter, controlData, control.<key>, revisions, revVersion, revDate, contents, openQuestions, questionCols[], userStory, storyId, storyName, storyUser, storyGoalLabel, storyGoal, acceptance, actionsTable, dictionary, confidential, figure, owner, openQuestion, none, comma ... An empty label is flagged by the check.

control.description: Adds coverTitle (cover title when it differs from the derived service name) and subtitle (cover subtitle) to the control fields; documentId is the cover spine code and the running header.

vars.description: Theme variables by role: primary, accent, ink, muted, rule, card, paper, signal, th-fill, th-ink, zebra, line, page-side, rule-w, th-rule-w ... Lengths are a number and a unit in one string ('16mm', '1.2pt'); line is a bare multiple ('1.8').

fonts.description: This document's font choice over the design pack's: a project font (Thmanyah, the default), a font installed on the computer, or a family from fontFaces.

fontFaces.description: Fonts uploaded into this document, printed through @font-face. A face travels inside the DOCX only when it is TrueType and its OS/2 fsType allows embedding (embed).

css.description: Advanced CSS for this document, sanitised before use: @import, @charset, url() other than data images, expression(), javascript:, bindings, backslash escapes and closing tags are removed.

chapters/*/hidden, sections/*/hidden, bl.description: Hidden from the PDF and DOCX, dimmed in the editor.

chapters/*/style, sections/*/style, bloc.description: Per-instance style ({css property: value}), whitelisted properties: color, background-color, font-family, font-size, font-weight, line-height, letter-spacing, text-align, padding, margin, border, border-color, border-width, border-style, border-radius.

manual.description: Harvested values edited by hand: pointer -> {generated}. A re-harvest keeps the person's value.

harvestConflicts.description: Written by a re-harvest when the source changed a value that was edited by hand; the editor shows them in the conflicts panel.
